description: Virtual analog oscillator free of aliasing, morphing between saw, pulse and triangle, with pulse width modulation

params.text: Offsets the V/OCT input one octave up or down
Offsets the V/OCT input three octaves up and down
Sets the pulse width of the wave, and gives the saw and the triangle the equivalent change of shape
Attenuates and inverts the PW input before it is added to the PW knob
Morphs the wave: saw fully counter-clockwise, pulse at the centre, triangle fully clockwise
Attenuates and inverts the WAVE input before it is added to the WAVE knob

inputs.text: Sets the pitch of the oscillator, 1V per octave
A control voltage added to the PW setting, scaled by the PW attenuverter
A control voltage added to the WAVE setting, scaled by the WAVE attenuverter

outputs.text: The audio output of the oscillator
